scope.notes: Crosses frontend, Java API/worker, PostgreSQL, Node runner, Helm, contracts, evidence and documentation.

integration.notes: Coordinates R2D2/Vertex, Core identity/vault, Sonic, ingress, DNS/egress and target applications.

infrastructure.notes: Requires real cluster, browser image, object store, service identities, ingress and network policy validation.

knowledge.notes: Requires compiler safety, immutable revision semantics, distributed recovery, browser isolation, media range behavior and enterprise platform knowledge.

risk.notes: Core security and evidence boundary; false readiness can execute wrong actions, leak secrets or expose sensitive video.

flags: Break implementation and external acceptance into owned work packages
Production verdict requires real staging evidence, not mocks
estimatedEffort: Multiple owned work packages plus external platform lead time
